insight: Certified by the nonprofit Fairly Trained for ethically-sourced training data; billed as the first fairly-trained AI MIDI plugin.
name: Lemonaide
tagline: AI melody and chord generator that outputs editable MIDI.
description: Generative music tool that produces melodies and chord progressions for producers, exporting both MIDI and audio loops you drag straight into a DAW. Its Seeds models are royalty-free, while Collab Club offers signature models co-built with award-winning producers. Runs standalone and via a plugin bridge so generated ideas land directly in your session.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary generative models trained on ethically-licensed material.

edge: Outputs editable MIDI (not just finished audio) and is royalty-free, with models trained only on ethically-licensed material.
pros: Generates editable MIDI, not just audio
cons: Focused on melodies/chords, not full tracks

references.title: Lemonaide: The World's First Fairly Trained AI MIDI Plugin
